decisions.decision: Use window_manager (v0.5.1) over nativeapi (v0.1.3) and custom C++
decisions.rationale: window_manager: 836 stars, production-ready, preserves DWM animations (NCCALCSIZE not WS_CAPTION removal), 12 WindowListener events, DragToResizeArea built-in. nativeapi: 97 stars, WIP, v0.1.3 unstable API. Custom C++: 696 lines to maintain, Flutter intercepts WM_NCHITTEST.
Hidden style uses NCCALCSIZE to hide title bar while keeping WS_CAPTION/WS_THICKFRAME intact, preserving DWM animations. setAsFrameless sets a boolean flag without storing title bar style.

decisions.decision: Window initialization in main.dart via waitUntilReadyToShow
decisions.rationale: One-step window config (size, center, titleBarStyle, minimumSize) at startup. Eliminates intermediate frame with native title bar. window.Show() removed from main.cpp.

decisions.decision: WindowService kept as thin wrapper over windowManager singleton
decisions.rationale: Maintains ValueNotifier pattern for existing UI code (CustomTitleBar, PlayerScreen). WindowListener mixin updates notifiers. Avoids direct window_manager dependency in kernel/UI layers.
